extraction_notes: Exact catalyst-performance values at 230 °C, 20 bar, 2400 h−1 are from Table 1. Additional temperature, GHSV, and pressure points were extracted from Figures 6A and 7 where the plotted points could be read against labelled axes; these are marked with qualifier '~'. Figure 6B is a 3D bar chart for methanol STY versus temperature/catalyst; non-table STY values were not extracted because the perspective plot did not allow reliable point reading. Supplementary figures mentioned in the paper were not provided in the input, so supplementary low-temperature 180 °C and other SI-only data were not extracted.
